_doc: Pearl's item balls (objects running Pearl's item-ball scripts 7000+n: file 370 script n+1, which sets the item and goes to its shared script 256) installed as Black 2 people (b2tools/pearl_events.py item_ball, installed_item_balls). Black 2's own item balls are people too (global script 7000+n, one fixed item each), so an installed ball is a person with Black 2's item-ball sprite (code 110) whose script is an entry of the zone's own file after its PearlArrive (pearl_story PearlData.item_ball_ids) that runs Pearl's own item-ball script: Pearl's lines, Bag check and jingles. Flag rule (one place, pearl_events.item_ball_flag): the person's hide flag is the ball's Pearl flag (its object's hidden_flag, Pearl's item-ball flags 986+n) by the id registry (data/pearl_story_ids.json: Black 2's item-ball flags 1100+n); Pearl's RemoveEvent of the talked-to object in file 370's code sets that flag (pl_RemoveTalkedObject: ActorGetSpawnFlag + FlagSet + ActorDelete, as Black 2's global 7000 Script_401), so a picked-up ball stays gone and a ball whose flag Pearl sets at the new game (the Storage Key: 0x4C8) stays hidden until a script clears it and AddObject shows it. Rows: zone (Pearl map name), obj (Pearl object id), item (the Pearl item its script gives: checked), what. 2026-10-25 (chapter 4b): only Pearl's HM and key-item balls (items 420-467, 5 in all of Pearl); every other ball and the hidden items (8000+: BG events) wait for the item-ball port (notes/OPEN_CONTENT.md), which can add rows or a rule here. Limits: each row is one more person in its zone (Black 2 makes 64 actors, the player and follower included: ov012 FldActSys_Create(heap, 64, ..)) and the item-ball sprite one more of the zone's at most 30 different sprites (patches/sinnoh_story.py SPRITE_LIMIT stops the build); a person's index in the zone's list moves the later people's (scripts are regenerated with it: pearl_story object_index).
